title: Your follow-up messages, for review
intro: These are the texts and emails LeadPro will send your leads, word for word. Mark each one **Looks good**, or click **Change it** and type the wording you'd like. Your answers save as you go, and nothing is sent until you approve.
footer: Prepared for ZZ TEST 2 by Law Firm Marketing Pros · November 2026 · You can come back to this page any time; your answers are saved.

sections.title: A new lead comes in
sections.sub: 3 emails over 2 days, starting the moment they reach out. The amber words are blanks we'll fill in with you; we'll also put your firm name in Email 3's subject line before go-live.

msgs.subject: We're Reviewing Your Incident Form
msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

We want to assure you that your incident form has been received and our dedicated team is already hard at work reviewing the information you've shared.

Navigating through the complexities of insurance and dealing with the aftermath of an incident can be incredibly frustrating and emotionally taxing.

At ZZ TEST 2, we recognize the burdens you're carrying, and we're here to lighten that load.

Here's How Our Process Works:

Step 1: Discovery
Once we accept your case, our dedicated team will carry out a comprehensive discovery phase. This involves contacting relevant insurance companies, obtaining police reports, and gathering essential information.

Step 2: Assessment
We dive deep into assessing the damages you've faced, whether it's mounting medical expenses, lost wages, or any other challenges resulting from the incident.

Step 3: Settlement
Our ultimate goal is to work towards a fair settlement with the responsible parties. Once an agreement is reached, we guide you through the necessary steps, including signing off on the settlement and receiving the funds.

To give you peace of mind throughout this process, we'd like to share some successfully handled cases similar to yours:

[Insert Case Study/Review]

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out. We are here to provide the support and guidance you need during this challenging time.

Kind regards,
[Team member's name]
[Team member's email]
[Office phone]
ZZ TEST 2

msgs.text:
Hi [First name],

In challenging times like these, making the right choice for legal representation is pivotal.

We understand the gravity of your situation, and we want to share why choosing ZZ TEST 2 is a decision centered around your needs.

First and foremost, we acknowledge the urgency in resolving your case. Our approach is designed to get you the compensation you deserve as quickly as possible.

Our commitment to efficiency is evident in our [XX] rating on [Firm website], highlighting our dedication to achieving prompt and successful resolutions.

But beyond our ratings lies what truly sets us apart – our sincere compassion. We extend our heartfelt apologies for the unfortunate events you or your loved one has experienced.

Our team is not only incredibly experienced but also deeply understands the complications that Personal Injury can bring upon a family.

Choosing ZZ TEST 2 means choosing a partner who prioritizes your peace of mind, values your time, and is dedicated to securing the best outcome for you.

No case is too difficult or complex for us. With decades of experience dedicated to practicing law, your case benefits from the wealth of knowledge and insight we've gained over [X]+ years.

Plus, with our “No Fee Unless You Win” promise, you can rest assured that your financial well-being is a top priority.

If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to reach out. We are here to provide the support and guidance you need during this challenging time.

Kind regards,

sections.title: Alerts to your team
sections.sub: These go to your team, not to the lead.

msgs.text:
Everyone on your team gets this text:

fresh Incoming Reply / Email / Call from:

[Contact name]
[Contact email]
[Contact phone]

Message:
test4

questions.q: Should your team get an alert for every new lead?
questions.why: Right now nobody is notified when a new lead comes in. The only alert is when a contact replies.

questions.q: Should the new-lead emails stop once the lead books a consultation or signs?
questions.why: Today all three emails go out even if the lead has already booked or signed.

questions.q: Would you like a text added to the new-lead follow-up?
questions.why: The new-lead follow-up is email only. A quick text on Day 0 usually gets a faster reply.

questions.q: Are these emails right for your practice?
questions.why: They are written for personal injury leads: they mention an incident form, insurance, a settlement and a “No Fee Unless You Win” promise. The practice area we have for you: Personal Injury.
opts: No, please rewrite them for our practice areas

questions.q: Your review rating, years in practice and a case result
questions.why: Emails 2 and 3 still have blanks: “[XX] rating”, “[X]+ years” and “[Insert Case Study/Review]”. Send us the details, or tell us to remove those lines.

questions.q: Email 3 promises “No Fee Unless You Win” and mentions decades of experience. Are both true for your firm?
questions.why: We only send claims you can stand behind.

questions.q: Which phone number should appear in these emails?
questions.why: The emails use the business phone in your LeadPro account, which may be a call-tracking number.
opts: The number in the email is right
Use our main intake line (tell us)

questions.q: Who should the emails come from?
questions.why: Right now the new-lead emails are signed with the name and email of the team member assigned to the lead, and those lines are blank if no one is assigned yet.
opts: The firm name and main email

questions.q: How do leads book a consultation today?
questions.why: There's no booking calendar in your LeadPro account yet, so the consultation messages can't start.
opts: We use another booking tool (tell us which)

questions.why: Every consultation message includes a Zoom link, and it is still a placeholder. Paste your link here, and tell us if some consultations are by phone or in person.

questions.q: Who should get the reply alerts?
questions.why: Right now every user in your account gets a text for every reply.
opts: Only the intake team (tell us who)

questions.q: Which replies should trigger an alert?
questions.why: Alerting on every contact, including existing clients, can be noisy.
